findings.status: connected already recorded current and historical conditional contracts; no new accepted unique count
findings.first_contract: The field finds minimum room-cell coordinates and computes each span by signed i16 subtraction and increment before casting to u32. It multiplies width, depth and levels as u32 before allocating, then uses derived flattened indices into the vector. The source model exposes cell coordinates and building/storey collections; the two dynamic building compilation paths invoke from_plan.
findings.safeguards: The inspected footprint_cells generator rejects width/depth above i16::MAX and emits coordinates from zero below each accepted dimension. That limits the straightforward single-footprint source but does not prove all BuildingPlan producer, transformation, deserialization, membership, cardinality and device resource policies. In the normal factory path, base_samples clones samples and contribution indices are built from the same dimensions and cell loop; no independent out-of-bounds contribution is established merely by finding raw indices.
findings.condition: A supported plan or later permitted field mutation must violate the relevant span, product, indexing or dimension/sample relationship, and no earlier admission may reject first. No accepted plan, overflow, allocation, GPU issue or runtime panic has been observed.
findings.future_direction: Establish a checked plan-to-field boundary and coherent cardinality/resource ownership while preserving legitimate zero/outside room sentinel, independently distinguish cell-span arithmetic from later field mutation, and retain normal factory coupling.
findings.historical_relation: Central REVIEW-INTERIOR-FIELD-CELL-SPAN-001 already records conditional signed span/product arithmetic with its own current source. 774 RIG-ADMISSION03-F033 records pr-working field visibility and dimensions/sample cardinality with original rig attribution; 774 SEGOVB-INITIAL04-CONTRACT-611 records full P16 operations. They are related but not automatically the same failure. 059 L12 connected TEAM020 and q2244 preserve the factory coupling without cross-lens or current transfer.

findings.status: independent bounded support for previously recorded conditional shutter matching questions
findings.first_contract: For each room opening, opening_light searches all resolved opening assemblies and chooses the first TimberShutter with origin within 0.01 m of the source wall centre and matching storey-adjusted sill. It does not compare the source wall/host identity in this predicate even though the resolved OpeningAssembly stores a host source. Missing match gives glass transmission and creates no shutter contribution; a match stores a typed OpeningAssemblyId for later scene-window lookup.
findings.safeguards: The caller already restricts source walls to exterior walls belonging to the room and excludes doors. The generator derives the resolved opening frame from a projected/return-adjusted wall span and an optional tangent offset; a common origin may also be produced for ordinary cases. A shutter starts closed, and the update later selects the first SceneWindow matching building and opening IDs, treating absence as closed.
findings.condition: For a missing match, an eligible shutter must be displaced beyond the tolerance and no different assembly match; for a wrong first match, distinct eligible assemblies must satisfy the same origin/sill predicate while representing different source openings. A supported generated or admitted plan, all scene/window identity and lifecycle guarantees, and observed daylight impact remain unproved.
findings.future_direction: Trace exact opening-to-resolved-assembly correspondence and legitimate shifted apertures, then choose an authoritative association or a precise ambiguity/missing-match policy. Preserve opaque and glass transmission, normal initially closed state and separate scene entity identity.

Do not count these as independent duplicates or transfer that reviewer's reads.

findings.status: prior source-scope relation, no new finding
findings.first_contract: Factory initializes shutter openness at zero and stores same-loop contribution indices and a clone of the base samples. On a sufficiently large change, the updater clones the base and adds each indexed contribution before clamping components; the field sampling function separately uses dimensions and a positive room tag. The lighting plugin orders shutter update before upload after transform propagation and chooses at most 16 fields within a 65,536-sample budget.

findings.status: bounded source trace and nonfinding, not a new unique defect
findings.first_contract: finite walks X, Y, Z in order and returns the first nonfinite component as GeometryError::NonFinite with its caller-supplied GeometryRole and CoordinateAxis. Position, Displacement and Elevation constructors call it and their Serde deserializers readmit values. Direction adapters translate Bevy Zero, Infinite and NaN rejection to the same named canonical DirectionError variants and retain that typed cause in GeometryError; direction constructors use the adapter.
findings.condition: These inspected paths do not prove all alternative construction, reflection or consumer admission, nor the pinned framework implementation of direction validation. No native invocation or serialization was run.

nonfindings.reason: It is the explicit initial closed opaque state, then current scene aperture updates can recompute contributions. No compatibility or unintended default claim follows from zero alone.

nonfindings.topic: Every field contribution index is automatically out of range
nonfindings.reason: The factory derives the index from the same cell and dimensions used for samples, then clones the original samples as base. Later mutation, upstream extreme spans and input validity remain independent.

nonfindings.reason: The shown Zero, Infinite and NaN variants are mapped separately to matching canonical typed variants; formatting at an eventual serializer boundary does not prove an internal string protocol.

nonfindings.reason: The factory has explicit dimension defaults and optional zero room tags. Full input semantics and GPU capacity remain separately open.

open_questions.question: Which supported BuildingPlan producers, edits or decoding paths can produce a room-cell span or field cardinality beyond checked signed and u32 arithmetic, and where is resource capacity owned?
Can accepted opening assemblies be shifted or collide at the same wall-centre/sill search location, and what source-to-assembly key should govern their correspondence?
Can fields/windows with the same building/opening IDs coexist across supported scene lifetimes, and are invalid or singular transforms possible when shutter synchronization runs?
Do active supported cameras and field population exceed resident upload limits, and what CPU-exposure/GPU fallback policy is intended?
Do all geometry construction and reflection ingress paths retain finite frame/role and native direction error provenance, beyond the personally inspected adapters?

lenses.assessment: Typed geometry role and direction causes pass from native vectors through checked constructors; daylight derives source rooms and geometric matching into typed shutter IDs and native samples. Earlier propagation records remain independently attributed.

CoordinateAxis, GeometryRole, GeometryError and DirectionError have canonical owners. OpeningAssemblyId retains a later typed identity, but the source-to-assembly join still relies on geometric comparison.

Geometry finite and native direction errors are checked at shown constructors. Cell span, field dimensions, raw plan collections and transform input admission require actual producer/lifecycle guarantees.

Signed cell subtraction occurs before widening and field product before allocation; checked footprint generation only partially narrows reachability. Shutter update retains same-index factory coupling while later mutation remains open.
Dimensions, sample/base lengths, room tag, contribution index and shutter identity form a related field aggregate; leaf-valid plan/field values alone do not prove their cross-relations.
Architectural coordinates, native direction errors, building/room/physical opening identities and GPU sample slots are distinct roles; common primitive shape or tolerance is not alias proof.

Opening matching reconstructs a resolved source relation from geometric centre and sill while an assembly retains host_source; actual matching policy and supported ambiguity determine authority. CPU exposure and GPU upload selection are separate earlier questions.

Both selected P16 and 95e files are byte-identical, not proof entire dirty snapshots or runtime behavior are identical. Preserve first nonfinite axis, typed direction causes, closed shutter and nonshutter transmission.
GeometryError and DirectionError express semantic categories, OpeningKind excludes doors and ClosureKind selects shutters; no boolean/payload reshaping required by the assessed path.
Canonical DirectionError manual wire serialization explicitly maps typed variants to stable native labels; semantic and external representation must be preserved before considering derivation.
A valid finite coordinate, nonzero direction, sampled room tag, aperture fraction and collection index have different purposes; none alone establishes the enclosing field or transform invariant.
Structured geometry failures keep typed role, axis and source; DirectionError native serialization labels are final wire values, not evidence of internal private string dispatch.
0.01 m matching tolerance, 0.001 aperture change threshold, 0.65 transmission, 2.25 square-metre softening and sample limits have distinct physical/quality roles. Review each under actual policy.
